d: Cristiano Ronaldo's recent B.O.A.T. victory has put him back in the spotlight, with his iconic 2008 Manchester United season beating Lionel Messi's record-breaking 2012 campaign in a special fan vote. But with supporters paying to cast their votes and Ronaldo coming off a turbulent year with Portugal, what does this recognition really mean for the five-time Ballon d'Or winner? Rupha Ramani examines the timing, the controversy and the story behind Ronaldo's latest crown.
